text:
sarah: Heads up — NovaHealth (dedicated pool dh-nova) requested a microbatch/slice change. They're seeing 99th pct tail latency spikes during long-context requests. They suspect KV cache churn + current continuous batching heuristics are over-aggregating small low-priority requests. Can we propose a token_budget + queue_limit that keeps their p99 < 350ms?

joel: can you paste the profiling traces and current config? need kernel+batch distribution to reason about batching.

sarah: posted logs and config below. sample p99 traces show spikes when kv_misses > 12% and avg batch size jumps > 3 tokens. current config: 
```json
{"policy":"continuous","token_budget":800,"queue_limit":64,"max_batch_size":128,"kv_prefetch":false}
```

maria: curious — their model is rdx-large-16k right? kernel selection matters: float16 matmul kernels perform poorly on sequences >8k; suggest forcing fp32 matmul for long-seq fallbacks when kv_miss ratio > 10%. that will raise per-token cost but stabilize latency. :thinking_face: 

sanjay: for dedicated tenants we usually tune token_budget to target 95% of microbatching while keeping queue_limit small to avoid head-of-line blocking. propose token_budget=400, queue_limit=32, and enable kv_prefetch:true (disabled today). kv_prefetch will reduce miss bursts.

joel: +1 on kv_prefetch. also suggest an adaptive queue ceiling: if avg_wait_ms > 50 and kv_miss_rate > 8% then throttle batch formation (scale down target_batch_tokens by 25%). we can implement as simple heuristics in the router.

sarah: nova product team wants the smallest change with low risk. their SLA cares more about p99 than cost. can we run a short canary?

deploy-bot: canary start: dh-nova pool -> apply config {"token_budget":400,"queue_limit":32,"kv_prefetch":true} to 10% hosts. canary id: canary-1932510001.

ops-bot: sched prof job: trace-runner job 1932510025 starting; will capture kernel timings, batch size distro, kv hit/miss per host for 30m.

joel: neat — after 30m can we get a diff of p50/p95/p99 and kernel time breakdown (matmul vs softmax) + batch size hist? if p99 drops < 350ms and kv_miss falls < 8% recommend full rollout.

maria: one more thought — we should guard against microbursting from small chatty clients: add per-client rate-aware soft ceilings so a single client cannot fill the queue. keep soft_limit=8 requests/client in-flight in queue.

sanjay: agreed. that can be enforced client-side at the router layer without touching runtime. low risk.

sarah: thanks everyone. action items: joel -> perf report after canary (1932510450), maria -> kernel fallback flag PR, sanjay -> router heuristic + soft_limit flag. i'll coordinate with NovaHealth PM.

joel: noted, running perf capture now.

maria: starting PR draft, will ping for review.

sarah: tagging @nova-pm in case they want to follow.

sarah: (follow-up) if canary looks good we'll target a rolling apply next Tue to avoid peak traffic.
